recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit. No FHIR-28172 follow-up is needed unless Vocab separately reopens supplement-sourced designations or automatic supplement inclusion, which were not unresolved gaps in the final published request.
issue_request: FHIR-28172 asked for CodeSystem/$lookup to support CodeSystem supplement content by adding an explicit supplement-selection mechanism and by exposing the source supplement for supplement-derived returned values. The final Published/Persuasive with Modification R5 resolution required a useSupplement canonical 0..* input, required supplements to be for the same CodeSystem, avoided automatic supplement inclusion by default except for displayLanguage/designation behavior, and added property.source and property.subproperty.source canonical 0..1 outputs.
initial_application: Commit 21c17e420fb3616a268b40a23f62ea29c6a6cbbb, merged through PR 2233 at 940b3e7619d433d2aba77b0637e55d38547129e8, added useSupplement and property.source/property.subproperty.source to source/codesystem/operationdefinition-CodeSystem-lookup.xml for FHIR-28172.
additional_context: The originating Zulip thread identified the need for an explicit $lookup supplement signal and clear provenance for supplement-derived properties. Vocab minutes record Michael Lawley's alternative resolution passing 5-0-0 on 2022-04-18 and a 2022-08-22 wording adjustment before application. FHIR-37529 is in the same supplement-parameter family for ValueSet operations but is outside this CodeSystem/$lookup seed decision.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. The current build-scoped CodeSystem $lookup OperationDefinition contains useSupplement canonical 0..*, property.source canonical 0..1, and property.subproperty.source canonical 0..1 with wording matching the final Jira/minutes text. source/fhir.ini lists CodeSystem as active and source/codesystem/list-CodeSystem-operations.xml references OperationDefinition/CodeSystem-lookup.
